newsitem.title: THAILAND: Land and Houses says no debenture default.
newsitem.headline: Land and Houses says no debenture default.

text.p: Land and Houses Plc said on Wednesday it had no problems meeting obligations of its 10-year, $60 million Euro-convertible debenture.
Land and Houses said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that it has not defaulted on the debenture's net 5.00 percent coupon payment.
The housing developer denied a Thai press report that it could not honour its commitments and was facing foreign exchange losses due to the issue.
Land and Houses said 86 percent of its debenture has been converted to common shares, leaving an outstanding $8.18 million debt from the issue.
The company said its debenture, due to mature on April 29, 2003, has no put option.
